meta.title: RigorQuant
meta.description: Unattended, context-isolated multi-agent research for empirical and computational mathematics: a declared RigorQuant preset, role-routed models with a Plugins-page card, and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane the orchestrator mounts at runtime.

en.description: Per-role model overrides and fallbacks for RigorQuant sessions. Left on Inherit, the DoubleChecker and adversary take the router's shipped routes (on DeepSeek Account when no API key is set); root follows the chatbox picker, and other roles inherit their session model.
en.roleDesc.adversary: Audits candidate methods and the checks themselves; eliminates routes only by concrete counterexample.
en.roleDesc.doc-adversary: Audits finished deliverables for self-completeness: every jargon term, symbol, and abbreviation used is defined.
en.roleDesc.doublechecker: Re-derives closed forms, invariants, and bounds from first principles, twice by different means.
en.roleDesc.explorer: Proposes candidate methods and routes with exact statements; spawned in parallel batches at each proposal stage.
en.roleDesc.lit-adversary: Independently re-retrieves and verifies load-bearing literature claims (validity and freshness).
en.roleDesc.lit-line: Traverses one research line (backward/forward citations) and writes a bounded dossier.
en.roleDesc.offgrid: Derives from the problem statement with raw model intelligence plus compute tools (sympy/numpy/…) — no web, no literature, no other agents' results.
en.roleDesc.root: Runs the whole study: plans, delegates to every role, checkpoints, and synthesizes.
